# VanguardArc

> Unified, custom platforms for legacy industries.

VanguardArc is an Albuquerque, NM-based enterprise software engineering firm specialized in replacing fragmented SaaS bloat with custom, unified operational dashboards for mid-market distribution, manufacturing, and fulfillment centers.

## Core Offerings
- **Unified Operations Dashboards:** Replacing disjointed SaaS with a single operational hub.
- **Legacy Knowledge Modernization:** Digitizing and indexing unstructured legacy manuals.
- **Workflow Consolidation:** Building custom data pipelines to eliminate manual data entry.

## Target Audience
Mid-market manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment companies struggling with off-the-shelf ERPs and disconnected tools.
